subject: Novaplace Week 0 Onboard — Ops roster, agenda & join paths
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Novaplace Week 0 — proposed ops roster & short agenda

Hi Emma / Novaplace team,

Thanks again for confirming Week 0 next week. To make the kickoff smooth for everyone, attaching a short ops roster and a proposed 45-minute agenda. Can you confirm who from your side will be joining each section below so we can finalize the bridge and the calendar invite?

Proposed agenda (45 min)
- 10:00–10:05 AM: Introductions & success criteria (Sofia)
- 10:05–10:15 AM: Network & SSO access walkthrough (Novaplace IT)
- 10:15–10:30 AM: Initial integration scope & data flows (Ben)
- 10:30–10:40 AM: Roles, escalation paths, and contact handoffs (Marissa)
- 10:40–10:45 AM: Next steps & immediate action items (Karthik)

Ops roster attached: Host_Roster.csv — please update the ‘Primary’ column if someone else should be joining. Also attached Week0_Agenda_v1.pdf for the internal runbook.

Question for you: could you confirm whether Novaplace prefers Zoom (default) or a Microsoft Teams bridge for the session? If Teams, please share the join link and we’ll publish it in the invite.

Thank you — aim is to lock the roster and final join link by EOD tomorrow so engineering can prep any short preflight checks.

Best,
Sofia
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sof ia@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from our side:
- We’ll use Microsoft Teams for the kickoff. Primary join link below (please put this in the calendar invite):
  - https://teams.microsoft.com/l/meetup-join/19%3ameeting_NovaplaceWeek0
- Novaplace attendees: Emma Stone (product lead), Jake Morales (IT / SSO owner), Priya Reddy (data ingestion)
- Jake will cover network/SSO; Priya will join the integration discussion for the first 15 minutes then drop off.

I updated the Host_Roster.csv with Priya and Jake as primary contacts.

Small ask: can you add a 5-minute slot at the end for a quick verification of dev/test account access? That will help Priya confirm our creds right away.
